verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an immigration case-preparation SaaS with guided intake and structured workflows, so user-defined event-triggered automation rules are a plausible axis. However, the evidence never documents any user-configurable rule or trigger-action capability. The "50/50 Rule" is a USCIS fee condition, and "AI workflows" refers to internal case processing, not user-defined automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
